card.name: Bolero
card.profile: The Cuban bolero is a slow, romantic vocal/song genre (also danced) that originated in Santiago de Cuba in the late 19th century - distinct from the older Spanish bolero in 3/4. 'Tristezas' by Jose 'Pepe' Sanchez (composed 1883) is regarded as the first bolero. It grew from the trova tradition of itinerant guitar-playing trovadores; in Cuba it is usually written in 2/4 with a son-related rhythm (bolero-son). It spread via the Trio Matamoros and Mexico's Trio Los Panchos across Latin America (English Wikipedia; UNESCO).
card.insight: The bolero was inscribed on the UNESCO Representative List in 2023 (file 01990) as a binational Cuba-Mexico element; UNESCO describes it as an indispensable part of the Latin American sentimental song (UNESCO).
